mentions.name: Nand2Tetris (Verilog implementation)
mentions.description: A Nand2Tetris part 1 implementation carried out in Verilog, yielding an emulated computer that can run programs written in the Hack assembly language; part 2 of the course remains to be done.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I did Nand2Tetris during the last Christmas holidays. I only finished the first part - I got it working on Verilog - so I basically have a emulated computer that can run programs in assembly language. Will need to do part 2 as well.

https://github.com/rishi93/nand2tetris
